title: Not so coarse, nor always plain: the earliest pottery of Syria
lineage: Original excavated assemblage and chronology, in the university repository. Later histories reuse these excavation results.

passages.locator: Abstract; early phases and ceramics discussion
passages.note: The earliest stratified Sabi Abyad vessels around 7000 BCE are small, mineral-tempered and sometimes decorated. The findspot of the earliest wares does not establish where they were originally made.
